answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Business Question ID: 2644 Country: India Title: Is it allowed to buy a car on loan? Question: Is it allowed to buy a car on loan? Answer ID: 2644 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 751/735=L) It is not allowed. But, if the bank includes the additional charge in the net amount and you buy it accordingly then it may be allowed. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
